spans.s:
mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Who or what gives a cow.
m. (-दः)
The brain.
E.
गो light or a cow, and द what gives.

f. (-दा)
The Godāvarī river.
E.
गो water, and द who gives: see गोदावरी.

m. (-न्तः)
1 Yellow orpiment.
2 A cow's tooth.
3 A fossile substance of a white colour, apparently an earthy salt.
E.
गो a cow, and दन्त a tooth, a cow's tooth, from its similar hardness, &c.

n. (-नं)
Gift of a cow.
E.
गो, and दान gift; also गोप्रदान.

m. (-णः)
1 A plough.
2 A spade or hoe.
E.
गो the earth, and दारण what cuts or tears.

f. (-री)
The name of a river in the peninsula, the Godāvarī.
E.
गो water, and द what gives, गोद and आवृ to cover or conceal; affixes अप् and ङीष्.

n. (-ग्धं)
Cow's milk.
E.
गो, and दुग्ध milk.

m. (-धुक्)
A cowherd, a milkman.
E.
गो a cow, दुह to milk, and क्विप् affix; also with क affix गोदुह, nom. (-हः)

f. (-नी)
A milk pail.
E.
गो a cow, and दुह to milk, with ल्युट् and ङीष् aff.

n. (-वं)
Cow's urine.
E.
गो, and द्रव what runs from.
